---
applyTo: "**/*.qml,**/*.ui,**/*.css,**/*.scss,gateos_manager/ui/**,docs/design/**"
description: "UI, design system, accessibility, and RTL conventions"
---

Use open fonts and project design tokens. Support light, dark, high-contrast, RTL, keyboard navigation, touch targets, scalable text, and reduced motion. Do not copy proprietary assets or trademarks. Keep UI state reversible and show clear error/rollback feedback. Render and screenshot mockups or UI changes at desktop and mobile sizes when practical.
